findings.title: Validation evidence is bound to a different commit
findings.impact: The requested acceptance claim concerns commit 24b9ef27, but all retained validation/provenance receipts reviewed here identify 35396b0. Because geometry and calibration behavior may differ between commits, the evidence cannot support production acceptance at the specified reviewed commit.

findings.recommendation: Regenerate independent geometry, calibration, and downstream evidence at commit 24b9ef27, including commit-matching blob hashes and focused synthetic/adversarial test results.

limitations: The review did not run full-stack inference or inspect other reviewers' outputs.
The retained replay is explicitly downstream replay from frozen 2D detections; audits/evidence/v571_rc5_candidate/tracking/tracking_replay_manifest.json:8 states that U-Net inference was not rerun.
Body width remains apparent mask width and does not establish PSF-corrected molecular chromatin diameter, consistent with audits/V5_7_1_DESIGN_DECISIONS.md:32-34.
The evidence does not establish biological group effects or anatomical seminal-vesicle volume.
recommended_follow_up: Run the focused measurement and calibration validation suite against reviewed commit 24b9ef27.
Produce a new commit-bound provenance manifest whose git commit and pipeline/profile blob hashes match 24b9ef27.
Repeat the geometry replay or provide equivalent frozen artifacts generated from 24b9ef27, including adversarial orientation, short-centerline, missing-width, and representative-plane cases.
